task_requirements: How technology has changed the workplace
Benefits of these changes
Challenges these changes bring

development_markers.requirement: How technology has changed the workplace
development_markers.1_mentioned: names a tech change with no detail of how it changed work
development_markers.2_developed: names a tech change AND describes a specific behaviour change (e.g., email replaced memos so people respond faster)
development_markers.3_extended: all of 2 AND a named tool, place, or comparison (e.g., at my office email replaced memos and meetings dropped from daily to weekly)

development_markers.requirement: Benefits of these changes
development_markers.1_mentioned: names a benefit with no further detail (e.g., it is faster)
development_markers.2_developed: names a benefit AND says who benefits or how (e.g., remote work helps parents stay near their children)
development_markers.3_extended: all of 2 AND a specific person, place, or measurable outcome (e.g., my colleague Anna saves 2 hours commute every day)

development_markers.requirement: Challenges these changes bring
development_markers.1_mentioned: names a challenge with no further detail (e.g., some lose jobs)
development_markers.2_developed: names a challenge AND explains its impact (e.g., automation replaces factory workers so many become unemployed)
development_markers.3_extended: all of 2 AND a specific industry, group, or example (e.g., in my hometown the textile factory closed and 200 workers lost their jobs)

task_requirements: Everyday actions people can take to help the environment
Role of local government in helping the environment
Examples from own life and community

development_markers.requirement: Everyday actions people can take to help the environment
development_markers.1_mentioned: names an everyday action (e.g., recycle, plant trees) with no detail of how it helps
development_markers.2_developed: names an everyday action AND explains how it helps the environment (e.g., plant trees to replace those cut for charcoal)
development_markers.3_extended: all of 2 AND a specific behaviour, place, or example (e.g., in my community people cut trees for charcoal so we plant new ones every season)

development_markers.requirement: Role of local government in helping the environment
development_markers.1_mentioned: states the local government has a role with no specific action
development_markers.2_developed: names a specific government action AND its purpose (e.g., strict laws on bush burning to protect soil)
development_markers.3_extended: all of 2 AND a specific policy, programme, or named example (e.g., in my district the council fines bush burning and runs tree-planting days)

development_markers.requirement: Examples from own life and community
development_markers.1_mentioned: vague reference to community without a specific example (e.g., people in my area do this)
development_markers.2_developed: a specific example from own life or community AND a clear environmental link
development_markers.3_extended: a fully developed personal or community example with a named place, group, or outcome

task_requirements: How shopping habits have changed over time
Benefits of online shopping
Drawbacks of online shopping

development_markers.requirement: How shopping habits have changed over time
development_markers.1_mentioned: mentions a change without comparing past and present (e.g., people shop online)
development_markers.2_developed: clearly compares past and present (e.g., before people went to the high street, now most order on apps)
development_markers.3_extended: all of 2 AND a specific behaviour, year, or platform (e.g., in 2020 my mother started using Amazon for groceries; she used to walk to the corner shop)

development_markers.requirement: Benefits of online shopping
development_markers.1_mentioned: names a benefit with no detail (e.g., it is convenient)
development_markers.2_developed: names a benefit AND explains who or why it helps (e.g., online shopping helps elderly people who cannot easily leave home)
development_markers.3_extended: all of 2 AND a specific person, situation, or example (e.g., my grandmother orders her medicine online and it arrives the same day)

development_markers.requirement: Drawbacks of online shopping
development_markers.1_mentioned: names a drawback with no detail (e.g., it is risky)
development_markers.2_developed: names a drawback AND explains the impact (e.g., scams cost shoppers money because there is no shop to return to)
development_markers.3_extended: all of 2 AND a specific case, number, or example (e.g., last year I paid 30 euros for shoes that never arrived)

task_requirements: Positive effects of tourism
Negative effects of tourism
Impact on local people, businesses, and environment

development_markers.requirement: Positive effects of tourism
development_markers.1_mentioned: names a positive effect with no detail (e.g., tourism brings jobs)
development_markers.2_developed: names a positive effect AND explains who benefits or how (e.g., tourism brings jobs to hotels and restaurants)
development_markers.3_extended: all of 2 AND a named place, sector, or number (e.g., in my city thousands work in tourism — hotels, restaurants and tour guides)

development_markers.requirement: Negative effects of tourism
development_markers.1_mentioned: names a negative effect with no detail (e.g., there is pollution)
development_markers.2_developed: names a negative effect AND explains the impact (e.g., crowds make daily life harder for locals)
development_markers.3_extended: all of 2 AND a named place, situation, or example (e.g., in Venice the canals are overcrowded and rents have doubled)

development_markers.requirement: Impact on local people, businesses, and environment
development_markers.1_mentioned: mentions only one of [people / businesses / environment]
development_markers.2_developed: covers at least two of the three AND describes a specific impact for each
development_markers.3_extended: covers all three AND each with a specific impact, named place, or example

task_requirements: Qualities that make someone a good friend
How friendships change as people get older
Personal example to support argument

development_markers.requirement: Qualities that make someone a good friend
development_markers.1_mentioned: names one or more qualities (e.g., trust, honesty) with no explanation
development_markers.2_developed: names at least two qualities AND explains why each matters
development_markers.3_extended: all of 2 AND links a quality to a real person or situation (e.g., my friend David showed loyalty when I failed an exam — he stayed and helped me)

development_markers.requirement: How friendships change as people get older
development_markers.1_mentioned: states friendships change without explaining how
development_markers.2_developed: describes a specific change AND a reason (e.g., we have fewer friends because work and family take more time)
development_markers.3_extended: all of 2 AND a personal or specific example (e.g., after I moved cities for university I lost touch with most school friends)

development_markers.requirement: Personal example to support argument
development_markers.1_mentioned: a vague personal reference (e.g., my friend is great)
development_markers.2_developed: a specific anecdote with at least one named person or situation
development_markers.3_extended: a fully developed anecdote with a named person, situation, AND outcome or feeling

task_requirements: How different seasons affect daily routine and mood
Positive effects of different weather types
Negative effects of different weather types

development_markers.requirement: How different seasons affect daily routine and mood
development_markers.1_mentioned: names one season or weather type with no specific routine or mood change
development_markers.2_developed: names at least two seasons AND describes a specific routine or mood change for each
development_markers.3_extended: all of 2 AND a specific activity, place, or feeling (e.g., in summer I cycle to work; in winter I stay home reading)

development_markers.requirement: Positive effects of different weather types
development_markers.1_mentioned: names a positive effect (e.g., sunny days are nice) with no reason
development_markers.2_developed: names a weather type AND a specific positive effect (e.g., sunny days give me energy to exercise outdoors)
development_markers.3_extended: all of 2 AND a specific activity, place, or example (e.g., last summer I started running in the park every morning)

development_markers.requirement: Negative effects of different weather types
development_markers.1_mentioned: names a negative effect (e.g., winter is bad) with no reason
development_markers.2_developed: names a weather type AND a specific negative effect (e.g., rainy days make me feel low and I cancel plans)
development_markers.3_extended: all of 2 AND a specific situation, illness, or impact (e.g., every winter I get a cold and miss work for a week)

task_requirements: When and why you listen to music
How music affects your mood
Personal example to support argument

development_markers.requirement: When and why you listen to music
development_markers.1_mentioned: says they listen to music with no specific time or reason
development_markers.2_developed: names at least one specific time/situation AND a specific reason (e.g., I listen on the bus to work because it makes the commute pass faster)
development_markers.3_extended: all of 2 AND a NAMED song title (e.g., 'Yesterday'), artist name (Coldplay, Beyoncé), or real genre (gospel, amapiano, hip-hop, classical, rock). Mood-based or function-based categories like 'spiritual songs', 'motivational songs', 'sad songs' do NOT count.

development_markers.requirement: How music affects your mood
development_markers.1_mentioned: states music affects mood with no specific change
development_markers.2_developed: describes a specific mood change AND links it to a type of music (e.g., fast songs energise me; slow songs calm me)
development_markers.3_extended: all of 2 AND a NAMED song, artist, or specific situation. Categorical descriptions like 'spiritual songs' or 'motivational songs' do NOT satisfy 'named song/artist'.

development_markers.requirement: Personal example to support argument
development_markers.1_mentioned: vague reference to a personal music experience (e.g., I love music)
development_markers.2_developed: a specific anecdote with at least one named song, occasion, or feeling
development_markers.3_extended: a fully developed anecdote with NAMED music (actual title or artist), specific situation, AND emotional outcome. A description like 'a song I memorised' does NOT count as named music.
